name: Corpus Delicti
description: Dive into the atmospheric sounds of post-punk with a live performance from the influential band Corpus Delicti.
longDescription:
Corpus Delicti, the French post-punk band, performs live at Auditório CCOP on May 2, 2026. Formed in 1991, the group is known for its distinctive sound, blending gothic rock influences with a raw, atmospheric aesthetic. Their work has contributed to the post-punk revival scene, establishing them as a notable act within the genre. This concert offers an opportunity to hear their material performed live.

Attendees can expect a concert experience focused on the band's musical output. The Auditório CCOP provides an indoor setting for the performance. The event is categorized as music, indicating a focus on the live sound of Corpus Delicti. The duration of the performance is typical for a concert, and the audience will likely consist of fans of post-punk and gothic rock music.

Tickets are required for entry to this event. Further details regarding ticket purchase and availability will be announced closer to the date. The Auditório CCOP is located in Porto. Specific public transport routes to the venue, such as metro or bus lines, can be confirmed closer to the event date.
